content:
Dear Mathlib contributors: I'm seeking a review of mathlib4 #42122 (my first mathlib contribution). Felix (@Felix Pernegger) kindly reviewed the Lean style, and I implemented his suggestions and resolved the review threads. The PR currently changes only one file and adds about 25 lines.

I especially welcome review from someone familiar with Hilbert spaces or continuous linear maps regarding the appropriate generality, names, and location. Happy to revise as needed. Thank you very much.
